name: motion-pose-vs-straight
title: Pose-to-pose vs Straight-ahead
description: Bài học: so sánh đặt các tư thế chính rồi nội suy (cho UI, logo) với tính nối tiếp từng khung (cho hạt, chất lỏng).

moworks.author: moworks

options.move: s per move between key poses (1), power2.inOut
options.wander: [x, y] reach of the wandering dot ([75, 60])

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Left: a dot eases between three marked key poses, 1000 ms per move power2.inOut (bezier .65,0,.35,1), looping 3 s. Right: a dot wanders on seeded smooth 1D noise (x ±75, y ±60 px; rates 1.3 / 1.1 per s) with a 1.2 s fading trail — the straight-ahead look. Kit port: the wander must stay a seeded pure function of time (no simulation state). Params: keys: các tư thế (3) · move (1 s) · wander: biên độ trôi (75 / 60 px) · seed. A lesson: key poses with in-betweens (UI, logos) against frame-by-frame motion (particles, liquids); the wander is seeded noise, a pure function of time.
moworks.titleVi: Tư thế chính và vẽ nối tiếp
